name: Skadi the Healer
notes: Thusnelda's apprentice healer. Does not speak Latin but observes like a scholar.
gm_notes: Thusnelda's apprentice. She does not speak Latin but her eyes follow every conversation. Trades knowledge for medical supplies -- specifically Roman medicinal herbs unavailable in the Germanic north. Understands more Latin than she lets on; she learned it by observation over several garrison rotations and has never corrected anyone who assumed she did not. Her assessment of the party: she watches posture, not words. Voice line: 'You carry yourselves like men waiting to be told what to feel.' She has knowledge of the grove that Thusnelda has not taught her yet -- she pieced it together from observation. The grove has been active longer than the tribe admits. DC 12 Medicine (treating her or her patients): she opens up. DC 14 with medicinal trade goods: she shares what she has observed about the grove's recent activity (it is increasing in Session 3). DC 16: she tells them something Thusnelda has not said, and she says it looking at the grove rather than the party.
objective: Learn everything Thusnelda knows before something happens to Thusnelda.
goal: Get the medical supplies the village needs, especially what Valeria does not sell to soldiers.
agenda: Assess whether these Romans can be trusted with what she knows.
secret: She has observed the grove at night. Twice. She has not told Thusnelda.
